description: Builds a liquid-chrome / Y2K metaball generator: an animated Noise TOP (or external source) is blurred, thresholded into soft blobs, then a GLSL TOP renders a procedural environment-map chrome look (greyscale ramp + moving specular highlight) with 5 metal tints and 4 background modes. Creates a self-contained baseCOMP with Speed, Blob_Count, Metal_Color, and Background controls exposed on the container.

background.description: Background behind the chrome blobs — black, white, studio (soft radial), or gradient (vertical chrome studio) (default 'black').

count.description: Logical blob count — drives noise harmonics + blur/threshold params (1–32, default 8).

metal_color.description: Chrome tint palette for the GLSL environment-map shader (default 'silver').

name.description: Name for the system container COMP (default 'chrome_blobs').

parent_path.description: Parent network where the chrome-blobs COMP is created (default '/project1').

source_top_path.description: Optional external TOP to use as the blob field (pulls in via Select TOP). When omitted, an animated Noise TOP generates the blobs.

speed.description: Noise animation speed — controls the absTime.seconds multiplier on noise TX/TZ (0–4, default 0.5).

name: create_chrome_blobs
title: Create Chrome Blobs
